# Die Mart

> Die Mart is a jewellery die (die mould) manufacturer based in Chinchani, Tarapur, Dist. Palghar, Maharashtra, India. The company operates 3 factories with 100+ karigars (master craftsmen), holds a design archive of 3,600+ dies, and has manufactured over 10 lakh (1,000,000+) dies. Specialists in bangle progressive cutting dies — the most technically complex category in the jewellery die trade.

## Company

- Business type: Jewellery die / die mould manufacturer (B2B)
- Brand established: 2022 (Die Mart); craft heritage since 1980
- Founder: Elyas Nagavadria; second generation: Hussain Nagavadria
- Location: Chinchani, Tarapur, Dist. Palghar, Maharashtra, India
- Market hub connection: Zaveri Bazaar, Mumbai
- Markets served: India, Middle East, Europe
- Working hours: 6 AM – 10 PM IST; CNC wirecut machines run 24/7

## Products (jewellery dies / die moulds)

- Bangle dies — precision-cut for every diameter and pattern; specialists in bangle progressive cutting dies
- Flower dies — decorative floral patterns (lotus, mogra and more)
- Thappad dies — flat press dies for bold geometric patterns
- Cutting dies — sharp-edge dies for cutwork and filigree
- Emboss dies — three-dimensional relief work
- Custom dies — bespoke dies to exact specifications, 7-day turnaround

## Services

- CNC wirecut machining (cutting punch, emboss punch, cavity — micron tolerances)
- Master embossing: hand, engraving machine, and laser emboss
- Three-point quality testing on every die: chaap (impression), pisur (alignment), faat (crack-free)
